title: GenArena: How Can We Achieve Human-Aligned Evaluation for Visual Generation Tasks?

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by querying the VLM judge twice with the image order swapped (A vs B, then B vs A) to detect if the judge's preference is influenced by the sequence or position of the generated images.

Evaluated by comparing the VLM judge's performance when provided an 'Explicit Tie' option versus a 'Forced Choice' setting, measuring the frequency with which the model defaults to a neutral judgment (tie) to avoid complex reasoning.
